quarterly_data.signal: FPT 9M2026 release: signed revenue from Global IT Services reached VND36,137 billion in the first nine months of 2026, up 23.1% year on year, and FPT secured 16 projects worth over $10 million each. In Q3 2026 FPT became a Global Partner (Select Partner) of OpenAI, introduced the MediSight healthcare AI framework, partnered with Vietnam's National Data Center in data, AI and high-performance computing, and with NVIDIA expanded the Nemotron-Personas-Vietnam dataset tenfold to one million synthetic user profiles. Its Flezi Metis AI platform, deployed for a leading US-headquartered automotive technology group (not named), cut source code search time by 50% in an initial pilot on about one million lines of code.
